description: The line plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for two models—attention-based (atttn) and feedforward network (ffn)—each with their respective outputs and residuals. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 24 on a linear scale, while the y-axis shows the maximum activation value, ranging from 0 to 400. The plot includes four lines: atttn_output (blue dashed line), atttn_residual (orange dotted line), ffn_output (green dashed line), and ffn_residual (red solid line). For both models, the activation values remain low and relatively flat across the initial layers, with atttn_output and atttn_residual showing near-zero values until around layer 10. The ffn_output and ffn_residual lines also remain low until approximately layer 15. Starting around layer 15, the activation values for all four lines begin to increase, with the ffn_residual line showing a sharp, exponential-like rise after layer 20, reaching a maximum value of approximately 380. The atttn_residual line also increases significantly after layer 20, reaching a value of around 250. The atttn_output line shows a moderate increase, peaking at about 100 near layer 24, while the ffn_output line remains relatively flat, peaking at approximately 170 near layer 24.
